style.narrative: Explain why each step helps, then demonstrate its real result
style.scene_pattern: standalone animated hook and CTA; demonstration and spoken instructions share the same frame
style.titles: large bright words matching narration, readable on a phone
style.cursor: add in Remotion using verified action coordinates and video timecodes; highlight target and show a single click pulse
style.zoom: zoom toward the button, zoom back, click; simplify if result needs focus
style.transitions: short, crisp, motivated by the story
style.demo_layout: reserve space beside or above/below real UI for large animated instructions; keep controls and results readable

music.source: reuse user-selected track unless asked to replace
music.generation_style: upbeat modern instrumental, subtle groove, no competing vocals
music.mix: duck smoothly under narration and native speech; rise in pauses

capture.device: iPhone, verified profile chosen for this recording
capture.viewport: use device profile; do not resize to export dimensions
